message:
"A new kind of local", yes, one that depends not only on the Venn-diagram 'net relations MRBS imagines (perhaps a Venn diagram with blurry lines, MRBS?), but a local that also depends on the way those 'net relations intersect with geographic relations (consider your community-college connection to Cindy, John, and the synchronicity Cindy and I have recently shown in our posts about New England weather -- and of course also the way the ideas exchanged have effects not only in this space, but out in the world).

And, yes, I'm hoping we might get something together in San Antonio. Time to start doing some Googling for possible places to meet, maybe.
